name: Line Sorter
description: Sort lines of text alphabetically, by length, or randomly
longDescription: Paste any block of text to sort its lines alphabetically, reverse alphabetically, by shortest, by longest, or randomly. Toggle case-sensitive sorting.
seoTitle: Line Sorter Online — Sort Text Lines Alphabetically | FileFolks
seoDescription: Sort lines of text alphabetically, by length, or randomly. Case-sensitive option. Free and runs in your browser.

faqs.question: What sort orders are available?
faqs.answer: A to Z, Z to A, shortest to longest, longest to shortest, and random shuffle.

faqs.question: Is my text stored?
faqs.answer: No. All processing happens in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
